scope_provenance: all five reviewed LH2_PIPE area bins use independent native transient equipment-twin runs with explicit isolation-success and isolation-failure branches through PH validation, SLABx-LH2/SLABx consequence chain and native TNO IR/F-N; barrier probability and geometry are synthetic; explicit facility namespace rebind to generic-lh2-near-receptor-diagnostic

events.source: Brooks, Ehrhart & LaFleur (2021), Table 2; DOI/report SAND2021-11595C; https://hysafe.info/uploads/papers/2021/44.pdf
events.classification_basis: synthetic one-metre LH2-service pipe boundary; not a site frequency claim
limitations: GH2/LNG-informed Bayesian LH2 estimates, not independently validated against LH2 field leak experience.
Discrete fractional flow-area bins; do not interpolate, smooth, or add Purple LOCs for the same physical scope.
Five published medians retained; distribution bounds use published ln-rate mu/sigma.
Pipe exposure is metre-years (HyRAM+ manual), not the number of arbitrary pipe objects.
Vessel bins need an explicitly reviewed reference flow diameter; do not use vessel diameter.
Marginal lognormal bounds; cross-bin correlation is unavailable, so summed bounds are not facility credible intervals.

coverage.meaning: frequency coverage only; not fraction of risk captured, not physical validation

aggregation_provenance.limitation: Native legacy risk.total_individual_risk and risk.fn_curve; expected-death convention; external physics/coverage must be checked separately.

timing.distribution: across cases; not repeated-run latency qualification

semantics.individual_risk: fixed person at each receptor; no population occupancy multiplier
semantics.societal_risk: native legacy F-N of expected deaths per event/weather/barrier/ignition outcome; not a joint casualty distribution
semantics.weighting: initiating frequency times annual joint condition times release/barrier branch times ignition; each once
semantics.endpoints: two declared radiation sensitivities and within-branch harm union bounds; not frequency credible intervals
semantics.population: disjoint outdoor groups at representative receptors; temporal presence in annual conditions

campaign_namespace_rebind.interpretation: A disjoint provider campaign was explicitly namespaced for facility aggregation. Source identifiers, partial case accounting and synthetic/operator limitations remain visible.
